item.description: Chastity Grant's first-half strike for Aston Villa is cancelled out by a late header from Alessia Russo, as Arsenal record another draw at home in a frustrating afternoon. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Are Celtic club in regression amid run of six defeats in 10?
item.description: Chris Sutton and Ian McCall weigh in on Celtic after a second league defeat of the season, but manager Martin O'Neill is defiant. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Chelsea put six past Charlton to top WSL
item.description: Ruthless Chelsea put six goals past Charlton - who are yet to earn a point in the WSL this season - to return to the top of the table with 27 goals in just eight games. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Retired Sheff Utd legend Sharp signs for Rushden
item.description: Former Sheffield United and Doncaster Rovers striker Billy Sharp comes out of retirement to join Northern Premier League side AFC Rushden & Diamonds as they prepare for their FA Cup match against Burton Albion. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Namibia overpower Ireland in series decider
item.description: Ireland captain Lorcan Tucker says his side will have "learned a lot" as Namibia clinch a 3-2 win in the one-day international series in Windhoek. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Alcaraz wins Vienna Open to maintain perfect record
item.description: Carlos Alcaraz extends his winning run in ATP 500 events with a straight-set victory over Alex de Minaur at the Vienna Open. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: How Dart revived career with help of Wimbledon champion
item.description: Britain's Harriet Dart knows people doubted whether she would ever win a WTA title, but says the belief of her coach Marion Bartoli helped achieve the best week of her career. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Defeat for London City against Man City - but is Europe a real possibility?
item.description: London City Lionesses suffer defeat by Manchester City but their performance suggests they are closer to Champions League qualification than expected. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Hardie clinches fifth gold as Scots win European Championship
item.description: Grant Hardie claims a record-equalling fifth European Curling Championship gold after Scotland edge out Italy 6-5 in the final in the Czech Republic. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Spence 'very proud' to break WSL appearance record
item.description: Tottenham midfielder Drew Spence says it is a "very proud moment" to become the Women's Super League's all-time appearance record holder. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Referee accidentally fractures college football player's leg
item.description: A referee accidentally fractures a college football player's leg during a bizarre incident in the first half of East Carolina Pirates' win against Temple Owls. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Dart reacts to her first WTA title after 'incredible week'
item.description: Speaking to BBC Sport, Harriet Dart says it's been an "incredible week" after coming through qualifying to win the Guangzhou Open, the first WTA Tour singles title of her career. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: He was homeless twice, now he is a billionaire
item.description: John Paul DeJoria overcame homelessness not once, but twice, before establishing thriving ventures in the hair-care and spirits sectors. A dedicated philanthropist, he signed the Giving Pledge to relinquish a minimum of half his fortune. Through the JP’s Peace, Love & Happiness Foundation, he champions diverse initiatives, especially food security. Notably, the Grow Appalachia program has empowered countless families to cultivate their own food. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: The plan England's rugby league bosses hope avoids repeat of World Cup pain
item.description: After England exit the Men's and Women's Rugby League World Cups at the group stage, the RFL announces plans designed to prevent a repeat. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.description: Yamaha withdraw from the Qatar MotoGP race - could there be implications for Formula 1, with two races currently scheduled in the Middle East to end the season? Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.description: The scale and spectacle of Tonga's Rugby League World Cup win over Samoa was not just an instant classic, it proved a demand for this clash that rugby league must find a way to supply. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
